subject: Unexpected session-replay charges — usage spike and corrective plan
thread_body:
From: Alex Soto <alex.soto@bluewave.ai>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden duplicate charges on July 21 — help needed

Hi Jasmine,

We noticed a sharp spike on our invoice for usage dated July 21. The ledger shows a set of sessions replayed about ~3x for a subset of our calls between 08:50–09:05 PT, which resulted in an extra ~120k tokens billed. Attached is a CSV export from our billing dashboard (summary + request IDs). Can you confirm whether this is a billing-side duplication? We need to understand impact and timing — finance will want to reconcile before our month-end close.

Thanks,
Alex
Finance lead
BlueWave Analytics
[Attachment: bluewave-ledger-export-0721.csv (CSV)]

-----
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: Alex Soto <alex.soto@bluewave.ai>, finance@bluewave.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden duplicate charges on July 21 — help needed

Alex — thanks for flagging this and for the CSV. I’m putting this thread into high priority and looping in Ben and Marissa. Initial takeaway: we had a transient replay issue in the request fronting layer at 08:52 PT that retried several in-flight sessions when a routing controller restarted during a deploy. We’re investigating whether the retries were double-submitted to the metering pipeline (still being determined).

Immediate next steps (what we'll do in the next 48 hours):
- Full audit of request IDs and server-side dedupe logs (owned by Product).
- Export of raw metering events for the 08:45–09:10 window (owned by Billing).
- Temporary credit proposal: we’ll provision a provisional credit to offset the excess tokens flagged in your CSV while we complete the postmortem.

I’ll share a summary and a proposed credit amount once Ben confirms. Apologies again — we know month-close is coming.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
[Attachment: acknowledgement-note.txt (TXT)]

-----
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden duplicate charges on July 21 — help needed

Thanks for the heads up. I reviewed the early telemetry and can confirm a short-lived controller failover at 08:52:12 PT that resulted in duplicate forwarding for ~120 request IDs before the dedupe gate re-synced. We should proceed with a provisional credit to BlueWave immediately and follow-up with a final reconciliation after we complete the audit.

Action items for this thread:
- Marissa: please prepare provisional credit for 120k tokens (estimate $360) and include a short one-page audit stub (timestamped logs + correlation of request IDs). Mark it provisional and reversible pending full postmortem.
- Jasmine: send BlueWave the provisional credit offer and timeline (48–72 hours).
- Finance/Billing: hold any collection activity for July invoices for BW until we confirm final numbers.

I’ll approve the provisional credit; Marissa, you have scope to apply on the billing console.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

-----
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden duplicate charges on July 21 — help needed

Done — provisional credit of $360 applied to account BW-4932 and I attached the initial audit stub (two CSVs: meter events and correlated request IDs). I added a note: "Provisional credit applied 2028-07-21 pending full reconciliation; will be adjusted after final postmortem."

Attachments: billing-audit-20280721.csv, session-replay-analysis.pdf

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

On Mon, 23 Jul 2028 at 14:12:00 -07:00 Alex Soto <alex.soto@bluewave.ai> wrote:
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: finance@bluewave.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden duplicate charges on July 21 — help needed

Thanks — we see the provisional credit on the invoice and appreciate the quick action. A couple of questions from our finance team: can you share the short audit stub you referenced (correlated request IDs and timestamps) and confirm whether the final reconciliation will be a credit or invoice adjustment? Also — can you provide an ETA for the postmortem? Our month-end closes on Friday the 27th.

Best,
Alex

-----
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: Alex Soto <alex.soto@bluewave.ai>, finance@bluewave.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 15:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden duplicate charges on July 21 — help needed

Alex — glad the provisional credit landed. Quick answers:
- Audit stub: attached (billing-audit-20280721.csv) — it contains the meter events and the correlated request IDs we observed in the replay window.
- Final reconciliation: likely a formal invoice credit (same net effect as the provisional credit) once we finish the postmortem. If we find any additional impacted requests, we’ll update the credit accordingly; if we find the initial estimate was high, we’ll reverse the provisional credit and issue an adjusted final credit. We’ll minimize customer impact either way.
- ETA for postmortem: initial report by EOD Thu 2028-07-26, full postmortem with remediation steps by Mon 2028-07-30.

Next steps on our side: we’ll send the EOD stub on Thu and schedule a follow-up call if you want to review the findings before your close.

Apologies again for the disruption — we’re treating this as a Sev-2 for metering.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: billing-audit-20280721.csv (CSV)]
